issues.detail: The skill focuses on happy path scenarios and lacks explicit handling of error cases and edge conditions.
The skill contains extensive explanatory text that could be trimmed for brevity.
The skill assumes availability of gcloud, bq CLI, and Python, limiting portability across all AI agents.

scenarios.name: create-partitioned-clustered-table
scenarios.rationale: Both responses use SQL CREATE TABLE syntax instead of the required bq mk --table command with the specified options.

scenarios.name: load-parquet-from-gcs
scenarios.rationale: Both responses correctly use bq load with --source_format=PARQUET, specify the target table, and provide the GCS URI pattern, meeting all rubric requirements.

scenarios.name: rank-products-by-similarity
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric, while Response B does not use AI.SIMILARITY or the specified model.
